names: P10 -- landscaped center island, Mission Bay Circle roundabout
summary: P10 is a park parcel labelled on OCII's December 2019 Mission Bay Land Use Map, tracked here as the landscaped center island of the 'Mission Bay Circle' roundabout (the identification rests on Pier & Point's reading of satellite imagery, not on a document; EPA's July 2012 fact sheet names 'Park P10 and Mission Bay Circle' together as one funded construction project). OCII's September 2023 open-space transition presentation lists P10 among the parcels the Recreation and Parks Department will manage, not among the 'when built' parcels, which is consistent with it being built by then.

milestones.text: EPA's November 4, 2011 media advisory announces a tour of Mission Bay 'to celebrate the completion of Mission Bay Drive and Circle'; Bay Crossings (Dec 2011) reports guests got 'a first peek at Mission Bay Circle, a landscaped turnaround that will eventually serve as a gateway to the park corridor'. Neither source separately dates the P10 island itself

OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation to the Mission Bay CAC (September 2023) lists P10 among the parcels RPD 'will manage' (transfer by the end of December 2023), not among the parcels listed as 'when built' -- an upper bound on when this island was built, not its actual construction date

facts.value: $760,000 EPA Region 9 / California DTSC Revolving Loan Fund hazardous-substances subgrant for the construction of Park P10 and Mission Bay Circle (soil removal/relocation, clean fill import, cap, methane mitigation); the fact sheet, dated July 2012, says the work 'is projected to employ approximately 395 workers' over 15 months and gives no start or completion year

open_questions: A 2011-2012-era EPA/DTSC brownfields fact sheet directly names "Mission Bay Park P10" (Subgrant 4, $760,000) funding its construction together with Mission Bay Circle, and a Nov 2011 press-tour article shows the Circle still not yet functional at that date -- but neither source gives an exact construction-start date, only that funded work was under way by 2010-2011. The original park/roundabout's exact start and completion dates remain unconfirmed.
Owner/operator beyond 'part of RPD's Mission Bay open-space inventory' not confirmed by any source found.

As of 2026-09-29, no source read dates the start or completion of Park P10 itself. The July 2012 EPA fact sheet (undated construction, 'projected' workers) and the Nov 2011 EPA advisory (completion of 'Mission Bay Drive and Circle') do not separate the island; the earlier '2010 under construction' milestone had no source for its year and was removed, and the Nov 2011 milestone's 'under construction' status was removed because the EPA advisory contradicts it.

Whether Park P10 is only the roundabout's center island is unconfirmed: EPA's fact sheet gives $760,000 for 'the construction of Park P10 and Mission Bay Circle' together, which looks large for an island alone. The 'landscaped with grass and trees' description rests on Pier & Point's reading of satellite imagery, not a document.
